subject: Access artifacts request — Clarity Health SIG intake
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@clarityhealth.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: audit@socsecure.io
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG / SOC2 intake — access control artifacts needed

Hi Chloe,

We're working through the initial SIG intake for Clarity Health and SOCSecure has requested a focused package of access-control artifacts to validate provisioning and enforcement controls. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the following within 7 business days?

- SCIM deltas for the last 90 days (CSV)
- Representative SAML assertion samples for successful and failed logins
- RBAC / role-to-permission matrix and current role assignments (export)
- Recent privileged-account rotation proof (service accounts)
- Short narrative on least-privilege enforcement (100–200 words)

Audit is copied for any direct technical follow-up. If you prefer, we can accept a shared Drive folder link with the artifacts.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Security Compliance Manager
Clarity Health
From: chloe_martin@redwood.com
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com, audit@socsecure.io
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG / SOC2 intake — access control artifacts needed

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. We're able to assemble everything but will need a couple of clarifications to scope exports correctly:

1) SCIM deltas: do you want full deltas for all tenants, or only the Clarity Health production tenant (tenant id attached in HubSpot record noted below)?
2) RBAC matrix: do you need point-in-time snapshots (as-of dates) or the live assignments plus a recent snapshot?

Tentative plan: Priyom will pull SCIM deltas and SAML samples; Laura will validate role mapping and the privilege-rotation artifacts; Sean will coordinate delivery and shared Drive packaging. We can target a 5-business-day turnaround once you confirm the scoping above.

I'll start a shared Drive folder and drop artifacts as we collect them.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Thanks Chloe — tagging in a short task list and acceptance format so we deliver what audit expects.

SCIM deltas (Priyom):
- Deliverable: CSV with columns (timestamp, op_type, user_id, email, displayName, groups, actor). Include header row and an MD5 checksum.
- Scope: Clarity Health production tenant only (tenant id = ch-4721).
- Window: 2026-05-01 through 2026-08-01 (90 days).

SAML samples (Priyom):
- Deliverable: 3 assertion blobs: successful login, expired session, failed-auth reason (anonymize PII). Provide accompanying metadata (idp_entity, sp_entity, time). Save as .txt and include redaction notes.

RBAC matrix (Laura):
- Deliverable: XLSX with role -> permission mapping, and a separate worksheet with current role assignments (user email -> role). Include last-updated timestamp for each row.

Privileged rotation proof (Laura):
- Deliverable: Access-change-log CSV for service accounts (2026 Q2) and a short note on rotation cadence, KMS integration, and exceptions.

Least-privilege narrative (Chloe):
- Deliverable: 100–200 word summary we can hand to audit; include links to enforcement checks (e.g., daily policy scan).

Packaging / delivery (Sean):
- Deliverable: Shared Drive folder, Drive link, and manifest.json listing files and checksums. Prefer internal retention 90 days post-delivery.

I'll start pulling samples and will post to the temporary folder. Chloe/Laura/Sean: flag any blockers here by EOD.

--
Priyom Das
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: chloe_martin@redwood.com
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: audit@socsecure.io, laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG / SOC2 intake — access control artifacts needed

Hi Marta — quick update and delivery plan.

Per your confirmation, we're packaging artifacts scoped to the Clarity Health production tenant (ch-4721). Expected delivery: Aug 24 COB (4 business days). In the bundle we'll include:
- scim_sync_snapshot_202607.csv (SCIM delta window 2026-05-01 -> 2026-08-01)
- saml_assertion_sample.txt (3 redacted assertions + metadata)
- rbac_matrix_v2.xlsx (role mapping + assignments)
- access-change-log-2026Q2.csv (service accounts rotation log)
- least-privilege-narrative.txt (150 words)
- manifest.json (file checksums + contact points)

Temporary Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Clarity-IAM-evidence (access granted to marta@clarityhealth.com and audit@socsecure.io).

Notes / open items for audit:
- SAML failed-auth sample contains authz error strings that include transient IDs; we've redacted PII but kept correlation ids for traceability.
- SCIM deltas are exported from the provisioning service; if audit requires raw event logs instead, let us know and we'll escalate.

Attachment: sample manifest stub and one redacted assertion (attached).

Thanks — Chloe

Attachments: manifest_stub.txt (text), redacted_assertion_sample.txt (text)
